entries.1b527f07400b1a75: Businesses in the housing, construction and civil engineering fields, including housing manufacturers and construction companies
entries.20d171959a205ca1: This segment manufactures and sells fastening parts (fasteners) for residential use and for general construction and civil engineering. Its main product is "drill screws," and it carries out integrated screw production at its Toyooka plant. Amounts are not disclosed by segment.
entries.372d2b75e81e8391: This segment handles fastening tools (tools). Consolidated subsidiary J.J. Tool Co., Ltd. plans, imports and sells tool-related products. Amounts are not disclosed by segment.
entries.3a13cd8f6bac465f: This business manufactures and sells fastening parts (fasteners) and fastening tools (tools) for residential use, including prefabricated houses, and for general construction and civil engineering. The company and its consolidated subsidiary J.J. Tool Co., Ltd. carry out this business, and consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥5,064 million.
entries.3ba83efa1066890e: This is a real estate leasing and related business. The reportable segment is a single segment, the Building Fastener and Tool-Related Business, and amounts are not disclosed for other businesses because their materiality is low.
entries.62fcd2f7e6a74b61: A company that manufactures and sells fastening components (fasteners) and fastening tools (tools) for prefabricated housing, general construction and civil engineering.
